lines.text: In the third year, Xerxes feasted his officials and displayed his kingdom's riches for 40 days.
The king then held a seven-day feast in the garden court for everyone in the citadel of Susa.
On the seventh day, the king sent seven eunuchs for Queen Vashti, but she refused, and he became furious.
Haman advised a royal decree, recorded in Persian and Median law, that Vashti never again enter the king's presence.
